generatedFor: Parent Epic 5 - Origin Detection, Currency Suggestion, and Nearest Airport Mapping
notes: Review-only draft data. This file is not imported by production code.
This is a suggestion-and-confirmation layer, not a silent fallback layer.
Unsupported origins should continue to return INVALID_ORIGIN until a reviewed UX and backend resolver change are implemented.
Do not treat IP geolocation as truth.

schema.mappingId: Stable draft identifier for this mapping record.
schema.inputCity: User-entered city or area name that may need airport guidance.
schema.aliases: Alternate user-entered names that can match this record.
schema.suggestedOriginCode: Globevoy/Travelpayouts origin code to suggest later, after product review.
schema.suggestedAirportCode: Primary practical airport code to show to the user.
schema.alternateAirportCodes: Other possible airport codes for review or future UI.
schema.suggestedCurrency: Currency to suggest from the confirmed origin.
schema.confidence: high, medium, or low draft confidence.
schema.requiresUserConfirmation: Whether UI must ask the user before applying the suggestion.
schema.warningMessage: Caution copy shown when the mapping could be surprising or risky.
